limitations: This is an authorized Decision OS #11 session compilation of the same 435 statistical series and 870 original observations in global-facts-01 through global-facts-22. It is not an additional dataset, a new independent provider, or a single agency publication. Original candidate manifest SHA256: c86c5f446cbf4200dd0ce1d75682e9771e95d7644619be3026af74d3addf1bfa

RAW RELATIONAL CSV: record_type=context holds shared original fields; record_type=series holds one original series and two observations. Join within this file on context_id. Parse the context record context_fields as a JSON array of the exact original column names to inherit. For those columns use the context value, including an intentionally empty string; for every other original column use the series value. Do not apply blank-value fallback, forward fill, or cross-file context lookup. Context rows are metadata, never observations.

Each shard contains every context required by its series and retains the complete original 36-column schema plus three relationship columns. Original numeric values, original value locators, flags and series identifiers are always kept on the series records. Reading only series rows omits inherited metadata; request all records in a shard before interpreting its observations.

Existing read-source reads this ordinary CSV as raw rows. It performs no context join, statistical comparison or automatic 16-column industry mapping. The lossless join was verified locally for all 435 rows and all 15660 original string fields against the unchanged original candidates. This is not native custody or a native reader execution receipt.

SourceInput origin identifies session curation in issue #11. Original agency, dataset, URL, byte hash, acquisition time, original publication date, units, periods, source locators, rights and limitations are retained in the relational records and exactly recoverable. Empty source metadata is not silently assigned. Local fetch time does not certify historical point-in-time availability.

All original measurement and rights restrictions remain. Series, sector totals, indices, stock/flow categories and compiler/upstream data can overlap and are not additive or independent providers. No rounding repair, interpolation, missing-as-zero conversion, back-solving, YTD subtraction, invented instrument basis or automatic refresh is introduced. PDFs, prose, full histories and credentials are not embedded.
